test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given query and arguments carefully and decide which of the arguments is/are strong.

Query : Should there be a complete ban on tobacco selling in India?

Argument 1: No, this will render thousands of workers jobless.

Argument 2: Yes, tobacco is consumed by even minors who suffer severe health effects.
solution:
Query : Should there be a complete ban on tobacco selling in India?

Argument 1: No, this will render thousands of workers jobless.

 
• Banning tobacco sales will leave thousands unemployed. This would be an extremely disadvantageous situation for India. Therefore, argument 1 is strong.

Argument 2: Yes, tobacco is consumed by even minors who suffer severe health effects.

 
• Consumption of tobacco by minors damages their health severely. This is also another disadvantageous situation. So, argument 2 is also strong.

Hence, both the arguments are strong.
